meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 它会分析仓库里所有开放的 issue 和 PR，逐项分类（问题、缺陷、功能等），为每项写一份带证据链接的分析报告存到临时文件夹；全程只读，不会在 GitHub 上留言、关闭或修改任何内容。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等触发词时触发。

say.note: 扫描所有开放的 issue 和 PR，输出报告。
只分析 issue 类条目。

say.text: 运行 github triage，把 bug 类问题挑出来。
say.note: 报告会标注缺陷分类和证据链接。

howto.what_en: Analyzes all open issues and PRs in the repository, classifies each item (question, bug, feature, etc.), and writes an evidence-backed report with GitHub permalinks to /tmp/{datetime}/. Read-only: never comments, merges, closes, or edits anything on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', etc.

say_en.note: Scans all open issues and PRs and writes reports.

say_en.text: Run github triage and pick out bug reports.
say_en.note: Reports flag defect classifications with evidence links.
